title: DevOps Expert with AI/LLM/RAG/Agentic experience
description: We’re seeking a DevOps expert with strong AI, RAG, LLM, and agentic experience and a focus on data privacy to support consulting work and potentially join our team as a fractional CTO. This role will help shape our technical direction, improve infrastructure, and guide AI-driven initiatives. We’d love to schedule a short chat to discuss the opportunity and see if it aligns with your expertise and interests. Please note this is a HANDS-ON job not just a strategy position. Along with a junior team you will scope, plan, develop and ship.
